subject: Re: Data Processing Addendum — Novapay signature route
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@novapay.com>

Subject: Novapay DPA: redlines and signature route

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed. Attached is our standard DPA with a handful of redlines (see Novapay_DPA_Redline_v3.docx) and a SIG/assurance worksheet. Procurement would like to confirm the signing lane and timeline: our legal needs counter-signature by 3/14 to meet go-live.

High-level asks from our side:
- Clarify data residency and SCCs language (we operate in EU + US).
- Confirm whether Redwood will accept our limited retention carveout in section 4.
- SOC 2 evidence: we requested the latest SOC 2 Type II or AICPA letter in the SIG worksheet.

Can you route this to your legal team and send a proposed signature flow (DocuSign vs emailed signed PDF)? Procurement is on copy for PO number coordination.

Attachments: Novapay_DPA_Redline_v3.docx (docx), Novapay_SIG-responses-03-08.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Head of Legal Operations
Novapay
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@novapay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novapay DPA: redlines and signature route

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear note and the files. Looping in Karthik (legal) and Lauren (sales ops) to triage. Quick plan from our side:

1) Karthik will review the redlines and flag high-risk clauses (data transfer/SCCs, subprocessing, retention).
2) We will prepare a counterproposal PDF and a single tracked Redline for your team by EOD 3/9.
3) If the counter is acceptable, we will execute via DocuSign (preferred) and route to procurement for PO. If you need a different lane, flag that.

Can you confirm: is Novapay willing to accept Redwood-provided SCCs with a limited EU export carveout, or do you need our standard customer-provided SCC text? That will determine the legal path/time.

I will keep this thread as the single source of truth.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Sales — North America
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Green <samantha.green@novapay.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novapay.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novapay DPA: redlines and signature route

Irene / Lauren —

I reviewed Novapay_DPA_Redline_v3.docx and the SIG worksheet. Summary of our position and recommended edits:

- Data transfers / SCCs: we can accept customer-provided SCC language but will propose Redwoods standard SCC addendum as a fallback. Customer-provided SCCs with unusual territory restrictions (non-EEA carveouts) will need security sign-off; request Novapay confirm exact text or accept our addendum.

- Retention (Section 4): Novapay's requested 5-year retention minimum conflicts with our standard 2-year default. Recommend a middle ground: 3 years with a documented exception in the contract. If finance requires the 5-year term for compliance, escalate to execs (expected budget/impact).

- Subprocessors: accept list-of-subprocessors commitment, but include notify-and-approval carveout for new subprocessors with high-risk categories.

- SOC 2 evidence: we will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II attestation under NDA. Ive uploaded the evidence pack to the Drive link and added comments in the redline where we need Novapay to confirm (see https://drive.google.com/drive/folderid).

Attachments I will push to the thread: Novapay_DPA_Redline_v3.docx (tracked with our comments). Plan:
- I'll produce a clean counter-redline (with tracked changes) and a short summary memo by 3/9 COB PST.
- Proposed execution: DocuSign envelope (https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123XYZ) addressed to Samantha for signature and Tom for countersignature. Lauren, can you prepare the HubSpot deal update and PO coordination? HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4839

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@novapay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novapay.com>, procurement <procurement@novapay.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novapay DPA: redlines and signature route

Thanks Karthik — that level of detail is helpful. Novapay can accept Redwoods SCC addendum as the execution path; we will not push additional territory carveouts. Regarding retention, we are comfortable with 3 years as a compromise provided that it is reflected in the DPA and the security annex.

Procurement (procurement@novapay.com) has confirmed the PO will be issued after countersignature; please proceed with DocuSign. Our team prefers Samantha (legal) first, Tom (CTO) second on the envelope. We will confirm the PO number within 24 hours of countersignature.

Next steps:
- Karthik/Irene: finalize the counter-redline and send DocuSign envelope by EOD 3/10 PST.
- Lauren: please update HubSpot (DEAL-4839) and attach the signed DPA when complete.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Samantha Green
Head of Legal Operations
Novapay
